_note: Major events for the clickable timeline. type: capital | breakthrough | collapse | encirclement. date = the moment shown; for encirclements: form = pincers start, date = pocket closed, end = pocket destroyed/surrendered; trapped = men encircled (sourced figure). zoom: camera zoom level (256*2^zoom px per world unit). The same format will be produced by the HOI4 importer.

events.title: Breakthrough at Sedan
events.text: Guderian's panzer corps crosses the Meuse at Sedan and breaks the French Second Army; the Allied armies in Belgium are now outflanked.

events.title: Panzers reach the Channel
events.text: 2nd Panzer Division reaches the sea at Abbeville, cutting the Allied armies in Belgium off from France.

events.title: Dunkirk pocket
events.text: BEF, French First Army and Belgian forces cut off on the coast; 338,000 are evacuated by sea.

events.title: Maginot Line encircled
events.text: Guderian reaches the Swiss border; French Army Group 2 is trapped against the Maginot Line.

events.title: Warsaw surrenders
events.text: After a three-week siege the Polish capital capitulates.

events.title: Battle of the Bzura
events.text: Polish Armies Poznan and Pomorze, counter-attacking south, are surrounded west of Warsaw.

events.title: Oslo occupied
events.text: German airborne and seaborne landings take Oslo on the first day of Weseruebung.

events.title: Paris falls
events.text: German troops enter the undefended French capital; the French government has withdrawn to Bordeaux.

events.title: Belgrade falls
events.text: Yugoslavia collapses within a week of the invasion.

events.title: Athens occupied
events.text: German troops enter Athens; Commonwealth forces evacuate to Crete and Egypt.

events.title: Bialystok-Minsk pocket
events.text: Panzer Groups 2 and 3 meet at Minsk; most of the Soviet Western Front is destroyed in the first week.

events.title: Smolensk pocket
events.text: Guderian and Hoth close a second ring around three Soviet armies at Smolensk.

events.title: Uman pocket
events.text: Soviet 6th and 12th Armies are surrounded at Uman.

events.title: Kiev pocket
events.text: Guderian from the north and Kleist from the south meet at Lokhvitsa: the largest encirclement in military history.

events.title: Leningrad cut off
events.text: Shlisselburg falls and Leningrad's last land link is cut: the 872-day siege begins.

events.title: Vyazma-Bryansk pockets
events.text: Operation Typhoon encircles the Soviet Western, Reserve and Bryansk Fronts; the road to Moscow is briefly open.

events.title: Soviet counter-offensive at Moscow
events.text: Fresh Soviet armies strike Army Group Centre at the gates of Moscow; the Germans are thrown back up to 250 km.

events.title: Second Battle of Kharkov
events.text: The Soviet offensive from the Izium salient is cut off at its base by Army Group Kleist.

events.title: Tobruk falls
events.text: After the defeat at Gazala, Tobruk falls in a day; the Eighth Army retreats to El Alamein.

events.title: El Alamein breakthrough
events.text: After twelve days of attrition the Panzerarmee Afrika's line breaks and Rommel retreats.

events.title: Stalingrad encircled
events.text: Operation Uranus breaks through the Romanian armies on both flanks; the pincers meet at Kalach, trapping the German Sixth Army.

events.title: Axis surrender in Tunisia
events.text: Tunis and Bizerte fall; Army Group Africa is trapped on Cape Bon.

events.title: Kursk: Orel and Belgorod retaken
events.text: The German offensive at Kursk has failed; the Soviet counter-offensives take Orel and Belgorod.

events.title: Rome liberated
events.text: US Fifth Army enters Rome after the Cassino-Anzio breakthrough.

events.title: D-Day
events.text: Allied landings on five beaches in Normandy.

events.title: Operation Bagration
events.text: Army Group Centre collapses: Vitebsk and Bobruisk pockets on 26-29 June, Minsk recaptured on 3 July.

events.title: Minsk pocket (1944)
events.text: German Fourth Army is trapped east of Minsk.

events.title: Breakout from Normandy
events.text: Operation Cobra breaks through at St-Lo; US armour reaches Avranches and turns into Brittany.

events.title: Iasi-Kishinev pocket
events.text: German Sixth Army is encircled as Romania changes sides.

events.title: Paris liberated
events.text: French 2nd Armoured Division and US 4th Infantry Division enter Paris.

events.title: Red Army enters Bucharest
events.text: Romania has switched sides; the German position in the Balkans begins to collapse.

events.title: Siege of Budapest
events.text: German and Hungarian forces are encircled in Budapest for 50 days.

events.title: Battle of the Bulge
events.text: The German Ardennes offensive drives 90 km west before being stopped short of the Meuse.

events.title: Warsaw liberated
events.text: The Vistula-Oder offensive breaks the German front from the Baltic to the Carpathians.

events.title: Ruhr pocket
events.text: US Ninth and First Armies meet at Lippstadt, trapping Army Group B.

events.title: Vienna falls
events.text: Soviet troops take Vienna.

events.title: Halbe pocket
events.text: German Ninth Army is encircled south-east of Berlin.

events.title: Berlin surrenders
events.text: The Berlin garrison capitulates two days after Hitler's suicide.
